proposedRows.title: Live animals browser tests prove how pages look by screenshot, accessible name and GOV.UK values read at run time
proposedRows.detail: Many live animals browser tests still prove looks by class list, fixed alignment, line height or a hard-coded colour, and find buttons and boxes by class. That breaks the programme rule that a browser test never writes a fixed style and compares only with GOV.UK values read at run time or a screenshot. The tests move to accessible names and roles, the looks they stop asserting move to the screenshot suite, the type-aheads gain accented searches, and shared test steps keep only what more than one spec uses.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live animals browser test that checks how a page looks proves it by a screenshot, by position or size against another element, or by a value read from GOV.UK at run time. None writes a fixed colour, pixel size, line height, text alignment or class list. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-225 followUps[8]; inc-226 followUps[0]-[5], [13]; inc-228 followUps[1])

The live animals browser tests find the Overview's buttons and commodity totals, the arrival details labels and the review's cards by role, accessible name or heading. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-226 followUps[0], [2], [4], [13])

The screenshot suite shows the looks those tests stop asserting: the arrival details medium labels, the transit countries remove column and the Upload documents actions column right-aligned, the Overview's buttons and commodity totals with their captions, and the review's last card. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-226 followUps[0]-[4], [13])

Each live animals type-ahead is proven in the browser to offer a matching name when the trader's search and the name differ only by accents, with the matching letters in bold. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-228 followUps[4])

A browser-test step, reader or selector used by one spec lives in that spec, and one used by several has a single owner. The live animals testing guide lists as shared only the steps more than one spec uses. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-225 followUps[8]; inc-226 followUps[10], [11])
Every live animals browser test and the animals screenshot suite pass, on both screenshot baselines. (loop:design-snagging-followups inc-226)

proposedRows.title: The live animals list shows a success banner only when an action sends the trader back to it
proposedRows.detail: Copy as new opens the new notification's Overview and never returns to the list, so the list's banner for a copied notification can never be reached. The banner, the flag that raises it, its English and Welsh wording and its tests go. The delete's banner stays.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the live animals list shows a success banner only when a delete has just sent the trader there. Any other query shows the list with no success banner. (jira:EUDPA-742)

Copy as new still opens the new notification's Overview, and both the copy and the original stay on the live animals list. (jira:EUDPA-742; repo:frontend notification-actions/controller.js:39, notification-actions.fit.spec.js:66)
After a delete, the live animals list still shows its success banner with the delete's message. (jira:EUDPA-742; inc-140)
The list's English and Welsh wording, and the shared action wording, hold only messages a page shows. (jira:EUDPA-742)

sources.ref: To Do, raised by a colleague: orphaned 'Notification copied' banner

notes: Sits beside inc-140 (success banner titled 'Success'). Both change the list's banners, so build them one after the other in the theme. Once this lands, inc-140's note that the copied banner is never reached no longer applies.

The wording lives in src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js and copy.cy.js (notificationActions.copy.successTitle and successBody). That is outside animals-dashboard's touches: add those two files to the theme's touches, or leave the two strings for a shared-copy tidy. journey-foundation, which owns shared/, is split off and merged, so nothing builds there now.

proposedRowEdits.change: Record ticket EUDPA-739. Add a note that the ticket's scope matches criterion 1 and names the parts to remove: the controller, template, copy, route, section caption entry and tests (on main: transport/transporters-select/, transport/page.js:22, transport/copy/copy.en.js:161, features/index.js:19, flow/section-captions/section-captions.test.js:26).
proposedRowEdits.blockStillApplies: Yes. ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 42 (c-285) blocks it on transporter requirements, and nothing since has settled them. Status stays blocked.
